title: SAML 2.0 interactive setup orchestration and invalid-metadata recovery flow
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Build an interactive SAML 2.0 setup orchestration flow for the Console that guides admins through metadata exchange, performs multi-stage validation, and provides clear recovery paths when metadata is malformed or keys rotate. The feature must integrate with RBAC v2 (only org admins can configure IdPs), emit structured audit logs for every metadata exchange and validation decision, and provide observability hooks (trace IDs, validation step timings) so ops can diagnose failed handshakes. This ticket implements the backend orchestration, validation service, and audit-event contract. UI and design comps are tracked in a follow-up design PR (see attachments).
acceptance_criteria: Admins can add or update a SAML 2.0 IdP via the new Setup Wizard endpoint and be guided through metadata exchange
Server validates metadata XML against SAML schema and checks for required elements (entityID, SingleSignOnService, X509Certificate) with explicit error codes
Fingerprint and certificate validity is surfaceable; when certificate rotation is detected, the system offers a staged rollover flow instead of blind replacement
Malformed or truncated metadata triggers a deterministic recovery path: dry-validate -> parse-errors -> allow manual-field override with audit log
All metadata exchanges (upload/poll/fetch) produce structured audit events (actor, action, status, validation_reasons, trace_id) written to the audit log stream
RBAC enforcement: only users with organization.admin role can complete final IdP activation
Automated tests cover XML parsing edge cases, invalid-entityID, missing certificates, and fingerprint mismatches
Integration tests exercise full wizard flow including recovery UI hooks (via feature-flagged endpoints)
implementation_steps: Create a new 'saml-orchestrator' microservice endpoint to manage wizard state and handle metadata pulls/uploads
Implement multi-stage validator: schema validation (XSD), structural checks, certificate extraction and fingerprint generation, timing/ping check to SSO endpoints
Define and publish Audit Event contract (audit.v1.saml_metadata_exchange) and add logging hooks to the orchestrator
Integrate RBAC v2 checks in the orchestrator open API; wire to Console's auth middleware
Add feature flag (saml_wizard_v2) and a back-compat adapter for older manual IdP flows
Add end-to-end tests and a small Canary rollout (10% orgs) with telemetry dashboards
risks_and_tradeoffs: Tight coupling of orchestrator to audit pipeline could increase tail latency — mitigated by async audit write with at-most-once delivery and retry metrics
Aggressive validation may reject legitimate IdPs with non-standard metadata — we provide manual-field override and a support escalation path
Rolling certificate replacement introduces a short window for failure; staged rollover attempts to minimize outages but requires coordination with customer IdP admins
Adding another microservice increases operational surface area; prefer lightweight service with clear observability and low resource footprint
qa_plan: Unit tests for validator components (XSD, structural checks, cert parsing)
Fuzz tests using truncated/garbled XML payloads
Integration tests that simulate IdP endpoints with various response patterns (200, 302, 5xx)
Manual verification steps for staged rollover: simulate old+new certs and confirm traffic continues
Security review to validate audit event content does not leak secrets (no private keys in logs)
observability_and_metrics: Validation duration histogram per-step (schema_parse_ms, cert_extract_ms, endpoint_ping_ms)
Audit events include trace_id correlated to request traces in Jaeger
Dashboard: SAML wizard funnels (started -> validated -> activated -> failed)
Alert: validation_failure_rate > 2% over 24h for newly onboarded orgs
rollout_plan: Feature-flagged rollout: internal-only for 48h -> canary 10% orgs for 7 days -> broad rollout
Expose debug logs only to orgs with support-enabled flag; do not include cert material in logs
Post-ship monitoring window: 14 days with daily review of validation failure reasons and support tickets
notes: Design reviewed with Samantha Li; requested clearer error language and copy for recovery flow (see design PR)
Security (Ethan Brooks) requested KMS-backed key wrapping for any cached metadata and strict no-logging of private key material
PM (Jordan Kim) prioritized staged-rollover UX for enterprise customers with rotate windows
We will reuse parts of ENG-31201's metadata parsing util but maintain isolated validator to iterate independently
